note:
Publishes the widened PDRN cream banner to the Skin Repair & Renewal hero. Same four section changes the firming page needed, because the two templates are structurally identical (main / hero / content / routine / faq / related, hero = image-with-text-overlay at image_size sm):

  enable_parallax  set false EXPLICITLY — absent from this section, so it was taking the schema default, and the theme's own help text says parallax crops images.
  overlay_opacity  70 -> 25.
  desktop_text     centre -> middle left; centre would put the heading across her face.
  mobile_image     added, an 820x848 crop holding face and jar together.

ONE VALUE DIFFERS FROM THE FIRMING PAGE, and it is the important one: object-position is 93%, not 78%. This jar sits hard right at x 1664-3634 of 3750, so 78% would crop 166px off it at a 1280 viewport. 93% keeps it whole everywhere with 26px to spare at the tightest width. Text max-width is clamped to 23vw accordingly — 294px at 1280 against 297px of measured clear ground.

CSS is additive in a custom-html section, scoped by .shopify-section--image-with-text-overlay (the section-TYPE class) rather than by section id: ids render as shopify-section-template--<theme id>__<key>, so a hand-built id selector matches nothing. Braces are kept apart because Shopify 422s an html setting containing '{{' or '}}'.

settings.html:
<style>@media screen and (min-width: 700px) {
  .shopify-section--image-with-text-overlay .content-over-media > picture > img { object-position: 93% center; }
  .shopify-section--image-with-text-overlay .content-over-media > div { max-width: clamp(260px, 23vw, 460px); }
}
@media screen and (max-width: 699px) {
  .shopify-section--image-with-text-overlay .content-over-media::before {
    background-image: linear-gradient(to top,
      rgba(10, 14, 22, 0.85) 0%,
      rgba(10, 14, 22, 0.62) 22%,
      rgba(10, 14, 22, 0.00) 58%);
  }
}</style>
